rows.partner: Hey Jason! It's so good to see you. How has your day been so far?
rows.ko: 오늘 회사에서 너무 바빠서 점심도 못 먹었어
rows.en: I was very busy at work today.

rows.partner: Oh no! So what did you do this weekend?
rows.en: I ate chicken and beer with a friend at the Han River.

rows.partner: That sounds fun. Do you go there often?
rows.ko: 아니 한 달에 한 번 정도?
rows.en: Do you go there about once a month?

rows.partner: What kind of music do you like?
rows.en: I like calm songs these days.

rows.partner: Are you a morning person?
rows.en: I don't like alarms. I turn them off five times.

rows.ko: 아직 정해진 건 없는데 제주도 갈까 생각 중이야
rows.en: I haven’t decided yet.

rows.partner: Hi there, welcome to Sunny Bean! What can I get started for you today?

rows.en: What cake is the most popular?

rows.partner: Do you have a return ticket?

rows.en: No, this is my second time here.

rows.en: I only have kimchi and snacks.

rows.en: I am an office worker. I do marketing work.

rows.partner: I see you booked two nights. Is that correct?
rows.en: Can I extend it for one more night, please?

rows.partner: Would you like a high floor or a low floor?
rows.en: I don’t care about the floor.

rows.partner: Breakfast is from 7 to 10.
rows.en: What time is checkout?

rows.partner: Is there anything else I can help you with?
rows.en: There is only one towel in the room.

rows.partner: Here is your key. Room 1205.
rows.en: Please tell me the Wi-Fi password.

rows.partner: Go straight two blocks and turn left.
rows.en: How long does it take to walk?

rows.partner: About ten minutes.

rows.en: It is far. Should I take a bus?

rows.en: I need the 2 subway line.

rows.partner: Do you see the big bank over there?
rows.en: Do you see the big red building?

rows.partner: Yes, the station is right behind it.
rows.en: Thank you very much. I am very grateful.
